question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Emancipate
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e. **'Liberate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Emancipate" **means to set free or release from a situation of bondage, oppression, or constraint.(मुक्त करना)
 
• It is often used in the context of freeing someone from slavery, servitude, or any form of subjugation.
 
• **"Liberate"** carries a similar meaning, referring to the act of setting someone free from restrictions or confinement.(मुक्त करना) It is the** most suitable synonym** for "emancipate."

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Liberate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Enchain:** This word means to bind or restrain with chains or shackles.(रस्सी बांधना) 
 
• **Fetter:** This word refers to a chain or shackle used to restrain someone's movement.(पाबंद करना) 
 
• **Confine:** This word means to restrict or limit someone or something within certain boundaries or constraints.(सीमित करना)
